messages:
deploy-bot: Release v2026.4.1 deployed to prod/us-west-2. Starting post-deploy smoke suite: kv-prefill, small-embed-synth, http-heartbeat. Will log results here.
emma: quick check: our change touched prefill init concurrency. can someone run a targeted prefill probe against the new hosts?
raj: running now: `./bin/smoke --env prod --probe kv_prefill --hosts newpool --samples 40`
sre-oncall: watching dashboards. threshold: prefills p95 > 275ms or fail rate > 5% trigger pin/rollback.
raj: results: 38/40 ok, 2/40 failures. p95=295ms. failures show `prefill-timeout` from worker host ip-10-3-44-12.
emma: that's above p95 threshold. suspect the init flag decreases parallel warmup threads.
ops: checking autoscaler and recent infra flags: no scaling events. found a feature flag `prefill_parallel=2` flipped in this build.
raj: capturing traces and logs. trace ids: t-9a1, t-9a2. errors point to sequential startup blocking disk read on a couple hosts.
sre-oncall: recommendation: pin routing prod/us-west-2 -> v2026.4.0 for 20m while we validate a hotfix. create alert for prefills.p95 > 280ms.
emma: I'll prepare hotfix that restores `prefill_parallel=4` and run a canary in eu-west-2 with 5% traffic.
deploy-bot: Applying pin: prod/us-west-2 -> v2026.4.0 (reason: kv-prefill p95=295ms). Pin duration=20m. Notifying rollout leads.
raj: canary started in eu-west-2 with the hotfix. initial probe: 50/50 ok, p95=120ms.
sre-oncall: alert rule created: prefills.prod.us-west-2.p95 > 280ms -> page oncall and post to #incidents.
emma: patch is looking good on canary. will promote hotfix image to a controlled roll after pin window.
ops: documenting rollback commands and the promote steps in the release ticket: https://tickets/redwood/REL-2026-4-1. added short checklist for post-unpin verification.
raj: after pin, will run a full smoke sweep and then trigger automated unpin if metrics stable for 10m.
deploy-bot: Pin active and monitors set. Update here when unpin scheduled or if escalation occurs.
